entities.summary: Albert Aleksander Üksip was an Estonian actor, botanist (hieraciologist) and translator. He published a part of his works in Russian as Альберт Яковлевич Юксип, so besides the correct form Üksip there exist several variants of his name: Ueksip, Juxip, Juksip and Üxip.
